For a large resort project in Hurghada, we are looking for:

* Female acrobats / gymnasts with dance skills

* Roller skating duo – male & female

Please send:

* Performance videos

* Nationality

* Current location

items.text:
Hi everyone 👋

Vlyt Art Acting is announcing the first intake of the Vlyt Art Acting Lab, starting in Pretoria this October.

This is not a casting call. It is acting training.

The Lab is an 8-week, zero-to-performance practical acting programme for aspiring actors, people who are new to acting, or actors returning to the practice.

The training follows the structure of contemporary international acting training — comparable to scene study and acting foundation classes in the US, UK, Russia and Europe.

For this first intake, we’ll be working with The Fraudsters, an English adaptation based on David Petrus du Toit’s 1892 South African comedy Di Bedrieërs.

We’ll work practically with text, character, physical behaviour, scene work, relationships, ensemble and rehearsal, developing the material towards performance.

📅 19 October – 7 December 2026
📍 Pretoria
🎭 Mondays & Wednesdays, 09:00–12:00
👥 Limited places available

https://linktr.ee/vlytartacting

sharedPost.text:
THE FRAUDSTERS

The first performance project of the Vlyt Art Acting Lab is an English adaptation of D.P. du Toit’s 1892 one-act comedy, Di Bedriegers.

Our English version is called The Fraudsters.

Five men are supposed to report for military service during the border war.

But they don’t want to go.

So they each visit the doctor with a different excuse: a stiff leg, blindness, deafness, a terrible stutter, and poverty with too many children.

They’re all trying to trick the doctor into giving them exemption certificates.

But when they return to collect their certificates, they meet the doctor’s beautiful daughter — and their carefully constructed fraud begins to fall apart.

Physical comedy. Deception. Romantic rivalry. High stakes.

And, most importantly, characters to play.

For us, the story is the starting point for the acting work. We learn by playing, exploring characters, working with text and developing the piece together.

If The Fraudsters sounds like something you’d like to play, applications for the first Vlyt Art Acting Lab are now open.

Pretoria
October–December 2026
8 weeks

Application in bio.

Vlyt Art Acting
Through diligence, art blooms.

#vlytartacting #actingclass #pretoria

Hi everyone 👋

Vlyt Art Acting is announcing the first intake of the Vlyt Art Acting Lab, starting in Pretoria this October.

This is not a casting call. It is acting training.

The Lab is an 8-week, zero-to-performance practical acting programme for aspiring actors, people who are new to acting, or actors returning to the practice.

The training follows the structure of contemporary international acting training — comparable to scene study and acting foundation classes in the US, UK, Russia and Europe.

For this first intake, we’ll be working with The Fraudsters, an English adaptation based on David Petrus du Toit’s 1892 South African comedy Di Bedrieërs.

We’ll work practically with text, character, physical behaviour, scene work, relationships, ensemble and rehearsal, developing the material towards performance.

📅 19 October – 7 December 2026
📍 Pretoria
🎭 Mondays & Wednesdays, 09:00–12:00
👥 Limited places available

https://linktr.ee/vlytartacting

items.text:
Do you want to see a brand new, unapologetically Scottish, lustfully sexy and culturally inclusive women loving women tv show?! 

SO DO WE!!! SO I DID! Above is the first couple of minutes of our pilot episode which we shot with NO BUDGET as a proof of concept for the series. The series follows a friendship group of 5 who all have their own stories about being LGBTQIA+ in Scotland. You can think of it as a mix between the L word and greys anatomy. It’s funny, sexy, chaotic and ALL based on true life events experienced by the writer Hâle and the people in her circle … along with some controversial media headlines. 

With what’s going on right now in Turkey and the BBC cancelling 3 queer shows in one year, representation is more important than ever. We need to remain loud and proud and continue to fight for our cause! The way we know how to do that is through the entertainment industry. Making authentic stories and normalising being LGBTQIA+. This project will also create jobs for LGBTQIA+ cast and crew.

To make the full pilot episode we need a whopping £20,000. So we aim to gain 50% of that from Crowdfunder… that’s where we NEED your help! Every £1-250 donated by the public will be matched by creative Scotland so if you want to help make this show a reality please donate. Anything you can afford to donate will be a HUGE help. 

The link to the crowdfunder is below where you can see our proof of concept video!

https://www.crowdfunder.co.uk/p/scottish-sapphics-tv-show

We own all the rights to the music in this video - thank you so much to Julia Hart for allowing us to use her unreleased song ‘Don’t Deny Me’ which will be featured on her upcoming new album!

And thank you to The Duchess - Kirkcaldy for letting us use this beautiful space!

Lots of love guys,
Team STQ x

#wlw #sapphicromance #lgbtqia🏳️‍🌈 #scottishfilm #indiefilmmaker

items.text:
SEEKING BLACK MALE ACTOR FOR LEAD ROLE IN SHORT FILM - PAID
I'm casting the lead role of Jesse in my upcoming short film, LOVED UNCONDITIONALLY.

This is a story about Black love, vulnerability, healing, and emotional honesty.

Jesse is a loving, devoted man who has spent years carrying the pain of family rejection. When an unexpected call from his parents forces him to confront old wounds, he finally opens up to his partner about experiences he's kept buried for years.

What follows is an intimate and heartfelt conversation about identity, acceptance, and what it means to be truly loved.

This role requires an actor capable of bringing emotional depth, authenticity, and vulnerability to the screen.

About the Film 👇🏾

LOVED UNCONDITIONALLY is a dialogue-driven drama centered on two Black men in a committed relationship.

Too often, Black men are portrayed through a limited lens. This film explores another side of masculinity: compassion, tenderness, honesty, and strength through vulnerability.

At its core, this is a story about being fully seen and fully loved.

REQUIREMENTS:

✅ Black Male

✅ Late 20s to Early 30s

✅️ Located in Los Angeles

✅ Strong Dramatic Acting Ability

✅ Comfortable Portraying a Same-Sex Romantic Relationship On Screen

✅ Comfortable with On-Screen Kissing and Physical Affection

✅ Professional and Reliable

To Submit

Comment "JESSE" below and I'll send you the submission link with all audition information.

Serious inquiries only.

Non-Union Project with Credit

Written, Produced & Directed by LeRoy McCray

ÉDIT : Trouvé, merci à toutes et à tous !! 

URGENT : casting figu couple 50 ans( âge apparent )véhiculé très BCBG/CSP++++ en figu pour DEMAIN soir VENDREDI 25 SEPTEMBRE sur CLAMART( priorité aux comédien( nes ), pas de candidature en MP et merci de VRAIMENT lire attentivement l’annonce jusqu’au bout avant de postuler 🙏🏻 )!

Bonjour à toutes et à tous,
Suite à une demande de dernière minute je cherche un couple pour incarner des habitants d’un quartier très élitiste de Genève.
Profils mannequins, élitistes, hyper luxe très bienvenus.

Horaires prévisionnels : 
22h00/2h30 du matin à CLAMART( 92 )
Pas de défraiement transport il faut être véhiculé, autonome et ok pour venir à ses frais.

Important : il ne faut PAS avoir déjà tourné sur la série !!

Tarif : 98 euros bruts + majoration heures de nuit

Si vous êtes intéressé(e)s, disponibles, que vous correspondez aux critères et que vous N’AVEZ PAS D’IMPÉRATIF HORAIRE sur le ou les jours pour lesquels vous postulez, merci de me faire parvenir votre candidature à l’adresse suivante : 

Uas.casting@gmail.com

IMPORTANT merci de préciser en OBJET de votre mail le décor avec la date pour laquelle vous postulez + votre spécificité, votre âge, NOM + Prénom, mensurations :  exemple «  25 SEPTEMBRE COUPLE, Sophie MARTINEZ 50 ans, 1m75, 60kg et Gino FAUSTO 52 ans , 1m85, 85kg », etc… 

Votre CANDIDATURE doit comprendre si possible les éléments suivants :
-Vos indisponibilités( ou disponibilités )entre le 24 SEPTEMBRE et le 14 OCTOBRE
-VOS MENSURATIONS COMPLÈTES( taille, poids, veste, haut, pantalon, chaussures ) 
-Origines ethniques 
-Couleur des yeux
-Couleur des cheveux 
- NOM et Prénom (pas de pseudonyme)
- NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE 
-Date et lieu de naissance 
-Lieu de résidence( adresse complète )
-2 à 3 photos de vous récentes( dont portrait, en pied et un selfie pris aujourd’hui, sans filtre )
-Préciser si vous avez des expériences de service, des compétences particulières quelles qu’elles soient( magicien, croupier etc etc )
-Préciser si vous avez des tatouages, des piercings, des cheveux colorés etc.. 
-Préciser, si vous le souhaitez, si vous avez eu recours à la chirurgie esthétique 
-Préciser si vous avez des tenues très chic/luxe/gala. N’hésitez pas à envoyer des photos de vos tenues si vous le pouvez !
-Préciser si vous disposez de tenues en rapport avec de futurs potentiels décors( serveurs, sécu etc … )
N’hésitez pas à joindre des photos de vous en tenues si vous avez.
-Préciser toutes les langues que vous parlez et le niveau et tout accent spécifique que vous pourriez avoir 
-Un CV et une bande démo( si vous avez )pour mon fichier et pour d’éventuelles silhouettes.
-Des images de vous en train de manipuler des cartes éventuellement pour ceux qui postulent pour les employés du casino
-N’hésitez pas à préciser si vous avez des talents particuliers : cascade, sport à haut niveau, musicien, danseur, etc etc 
-Préciser si vous êtes autonomes et par quel moyen( voiture, scooter, vélo, trottinette etc )
-Préciser si vous êtes ok pour faire du co voiturage pour les personnes disposant d’une voiture
-Préciser la marque et la couleur de votre voiture 
-Des photos de votre voiture, scooter, vélo etc pour celles et ceux qui en ont.

Par avance désolée car je ne pourrai malheureusement pas répondre à tout le monde. Je vous re contacterai dès que possible si votre profil correspond. 

Merci par avance à toutes et à tous pour vos futurs envois et belle journée ! 🙂

Anne Arovas, assistée d’Angèle Chenais
Uas.casting@gmail.com

If you’re ready to stop waiting for the occasional commercial audition to roll in and start getting more TV and film auditions:

Hi everyone! 💗✨

I have some exciting news to share! 🥹💕 I’m starting a new journey as a member of the P-Pop group SL8Y! 🎤💃🏻

KATSEYE inspires me so much because of how they share their talents with people around the world. 🌎💖 I also want to keep learning, performing, and sharing my love for singing and dancing with everyone! 🥰

I hope you can support me on this new journey! 🫶🏻 Please like my video and leave some love in the comments. 💕 You can also add me as a friend on Kenzey Achanté and follow my page KenzSlay to see more of my videos and updates! 🎶💃🏻

Thank you so much for supporting me! 💗✨ It means a lot! 🥹🫶🏻

Love,
Kenzey 💕

🎶Thinking about voice lessons? Free Trial Lessons Available!🎶

Looking for a fun, supportive voice teacher for you or your child? Give them the opportunity to build confidence, strengthen their voice, and develop their performance skills all from the comfort of home!

Hi! I’m Colleen, a professional actress/singer, and voice and piano teacher! I offer private voice lessons entirely online through Zoom.

✨ Beginner-friendly

🎶 Musical theatre, pop & more

🎤 Build vocal technique and confidence

💻 Convenient online lessons from home

❤️ In-person recitals in Milwaukee at least 2x per year!

If your child has been singing around the house, dreaming of performing, or just wants to try something new this school year, this is a great time to get started.

Fill out our free trial lesson form and I’ll be in touch!

www.virtuosostudios.org/free-trial-lessons

**Casting do reklamy telewizyjnej dla sieci sklepów spożywczych! **

**ŚWIĘTY MIKOŁAJ – rola główna**
* wiek ekranowy: **50–60 lat**
* poczciwa, ciepła uroda
* twarz i charakter, które naturalnie kojarzą się ze Świętym Mikołajem
* miła, sympatyczna i charyzmatyczna twarz
* osoba, która dobrze czuje się przed kamerą

**Zdjęcia:** 02.10.2026r. + dodatkowo planowany jest **1 dzień nagrań do social media + sesja zdjęciowa** – dokładna data do potwierdzenia, ale na pewno w październiku.

**Lokalizacja:** do potwierdzenia (Warszawa/okolice Warszawy/okolice Łodzi) 

**Prawa: **TV, digital i print -** **do końca 2026r. + archiwizacja w Internecie

**Stawka: **10 000 zł netto

**ELF 1 – rola drugoplanowa**
* wiek ekranowy: **około 40 lat**
* **niski wzrost – maksymalnie 150 cm**
* charakterystyczna, sympatyczna uroda
* naturalnie zabawny, lekko nieporadny / „ciapciowaty” charakter
* swobodny przed kamerą
* mile widziane **loczki lub charakterystyczna fryzura**
* ważna jest wyrazista osobowość i komediowy potencjał

**Zdjęcia:** 02.10.2026

**Lokalizacja:** do potwierdzenia (Warszawa/okolice Warszawy/okolice Łodzi)

**Prawa: **TV i digital -** **do końca 2026r. + archiwizacja w Internecie

**Stawka:** 3 500 zł netto 

**ELF 2 – rola drugoplanowa**
* wiek ekranowy: **około 40 lat**
* **wysoki wzrost – minimum 190 cm**
* charakterystyczna, sympatyczna uroda
* lekko nieporadny, zabawny charakter
* naturalna swoboda przed kamerą
* wyrazista osobowość i komediowy potencjał

**Zdjęcia:** 02.10.2026

**Lokalizacja:** do potwierdzenia (Warszawa/okolice Warszawy/okolice Łodzi)

**Prawa: **TV i digital -** **do końca 2026r. + archiwizacja w Internecie

**Stawka:** 3 500 zł netto 

**Etapy castingu**
1. Zgłoszenie
2. Wybór osób do kolejnego etapu
3. **Self-tape na podstawie briefu** – szczegóły zostaną przesłane wybranym osobom

**Zgłoszenia:**  casting.scprojects@gmail.com

**Czekamy na zgłoszenia do wtorku, 29.09.2026, do godz. 12:00.**

W zgłoszeniu prosimy o przesłanie **aktualnych zdjęć, podstawowych informacji o sobie oraz demo aktorskiego**.

Skontaktujemy się z wybranymi osobami i przekażemy szczegóły dotyczące self-tape'u.

Na podstawie powieści "Zły" Leopolda Tyrmanda tworzymy krótkometrażowy film fabularny!! 🎬️
Film jest realizowany w ramach Stypendium Kulturalnego Miasta Kalisza przez grupę Butcher Studios

Do zdjęć, które odbędą się 28 września poszukujemy statystów

🍿 bez piercingów

🍿 bez widocznych tatuaży

Projekt bez wynagrodzenia 💰️

Zdjęcia odbywają się w Kaliszu📍

Zgłoszenia prosimy kierować do Jagoda Banaszyńska

CASTING CALL - N.E.S.T. PROJECT @everyone
We’re looking for people to join us on 24th and 25th September as we continue filming the N.E.S.T. Project in Mossley, Tameside.
Whether you’ve acted before or this is your first time in front of a camera, we’d love to hear from you. No previous experience is required.
N.E.S.T. is a voluntary independent film project, so this is an unpaid opportunity. Those involved will also have the opportunity to receive IMDb credits for their contribution to the project.
If you’re interested in getting involved, please
email casting@emberproduction.com with a little information about yourself and your interest in joining the cast. Our team will be happy to provide further details.
We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who has supported the project so far, and we look forward to welcoming more people into the N.E.S.T. family.
Dates: 24th & 25th September
Location: Mossley, Tameside
Experience: None required
#NESTProject #EmberProductions #CastingCall #IndependentFilm #Mossley

KTO CHĘTNY NA ZAJĘCIA AKTORSKIE?!

Siemano liptoniary!

Szukam jeszcze około 8 osób chętnych na zajęcia aktorskie(w Poznaniu) ponieważ potrzebujemy jeszcze kilku osób żeby otworzyć grupę!!

Jeśli zawsze chciałyście spróbować swoich sił w aktorstwie albo po prostu macie ochotę nauczyć się czegoś nowego to mega zachęcam do dołączenia.

Nie trzeba mieć doświadczenia liczą się chęci i dobra zabawa.

Ta grupa będzie dla osób w wieku 13–19 lat,ale jeśli masz 9–10 lat to też jak najbardziej jesteś mile widziana / mile widziany!!Dla młodszych dzieci będzie po prostu osobna grupa wiekowa.

Potrzebujemy jezcze około 8 osób żeby ruszyć z grupą więc jeśli masz ochotę spróbować swoich sił w aktorstwie to pisz(powiem co mniej wiecej ale ja ich nie tworzę)!!(naprawde moze byc ciekawie i super  )

‘GIVE ME SHELTER’ EXPANDS INTERNATIONAL FESTIVAL RUN WITH MILAN SELECTION
Don Haderlein’s GIVE ME SHELTER has secured another international festival berth, with the award-winning documentary officially selected for the Union Cinema Film Festival in Milan, Italy.
The latest selection adds another international stop to the film’s growing festival run, following its reception on the independent documentary circuit.
The Los Angeles-set film examines homelessness through the people living it—and the systems surrounding them—bringing an urgent American story to audiences abroad.
Official Selection | Union Cinema Film Festival | Milan, Italy
🎬 Directed by Don Haderlein
North Hollywood Pictures
International festival rollout continues.
#GiveMeShelter #DonHaderlein #UnionCinemaFilmFestival #Milan #Italy #DocumentaryFilm #IndependentFilm #OfficialSelection #FilmFestival #NorthHollywoodPictures

Don Haderlein’s GIVE ME SHELTER continues its international festival run, officially selected for the Union Cinema Film Festival in Milan, Italy.

From Los Angeles to Milan, GIVE ME SHELTER continues its international rollout.

Kollektiv is a booking, payment and management platform built for Berlin’s independent creative scene—from DJs and tattoo artists to photographers, designers, performers and collectives.

With one public link, people can discover your work, book services or events and pay without creating an account. Creators manage bookings, income, collaborator splits, guest lists, secret locations and German-compliant invoices from one simple dashboard.

Built in Berlin. Made for the scene. 🖤💚

Discover Kollektiv:
[https://kollektiv-link-studio.lovable.app](https://kollektiv-link-studio.lovable.app/)

#Kollektiv #BerlinCreatives #IndependentArtists #CreatorEconomy

With one public link, people can discover your work, book services or events and pay without creating an account. Creators manage bookings, income, collaborator splits, guest lists, secret locations and German-compliant invoices from one simple dashboard.

Built in Berlin. Made for the scene. 🖤💚

Discover Kollektiv:
[https://kollektiv-link-studio.lovable.app](https://kollektiv-link-studio.lovable.app/)

#Kollektiv #BerlinCreatives #IndependentArtists #CreatorEconomy

I am Thomas Goersch. A filmdirector from Germany.  I am looking for all kind of Actors for my next movie Just Go - The Day I left Kevin Costner  
I am a filmmaker working on Indendent Shortmovies to present on many international filmfestivals all around the word.
You can earn no money with these movies and so do I. The movies I made received about 400 awards and had a good attention.
I am starting next the second shooting part of my my next movie.
The Idea of the movie is:
40 actors are telling one story in a Video Chat. 
Every actor with 2-3 sentences. Every actor is shooting on his own with his smart phone. It would be perfect to have a great mixture from serveral countries.
Please watch at my imdb side to know more about me.
www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Every actor will get a credit on imdb and for sure in the movie. 
Please ask for more informations.
Best Thomas Goersch

Please write to : Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de

NON-UNION 

$2,000/DAY — SEEKING REAL ADVENTURERS WHO CAN ACT

Sliding down a grassy hill like you're sledding on snow. Likely wire-assisted, so a rig drags you down. The rig does the work — you sell the ride.

Ages 18–35, all genders and ethnicities. Comfortable in a harness. 

1–2 days in BC, Canada between Sept 28 – Oct 3. Non-union. $500/day travel, flights and hotel covered. Client is Nike.

Skiers, snowboarders, parkour athletes, climbers, aerialists, bikers, skaters — this is you.

Full details and submissions:

https://www.stuntlisting.com/jobs/152

Deadline Tuesday at 4:00 pm pst. — Brady Romberg, Casting

items.text:
🎬 **BACKGROUND ACTORS + CHILD EXTRAS NEEDED!** 👽🐛

We’re looking for **volunteer background actors and child extras** for a film shoot in **Surrey on Monday, October 26th!**

We have **three scenes** looking for background:

🚗 **STREET / CAR SCENE**
We’re looking for a variety of people to bring the world around our main character to life — **parents with strollers, teenagers skateboarding, couples with a puppy, people with balloons, groups in matching outfits, anime cosplayers, and more!**

The scene starts out feeling like an ordinary day, but gradually becomes more eccentric, so we’re especially interested in people with **interesting looks, costumes, groups, or fun ideas.**

📱 **GAS STATION / TIKTOK SCENE**
We’re looking for **people who are willing to dance and appear as TikTok dancers** at a gas station. You’ll be part of a fun background moment featuring a group filming a TikTok to an upbeat electronic remix. 💃🕺

🪲 **BUG ZOO SCENE — CHILD EXTRAS NEEDED!**
We’re looking for **children to play visitors at a bug zoo**. The kids will be part of a guided tour where they get to see and learn about **insects and animals**, including a large stick insect! 🐛

No acting experience is necessary — just a willingness to participate and have fun on set!

**This is a volunteer production, so these are unpaid background roles.**

📍 **Location:** Surrey, BC
📅 **Date:** Monday, October 26th
🎥 **Roles:** Background actors + child extras

📧 **INTERESTED?**

Please email **wemetaliens2026@gmail.com** with the subject:

**“BG Available: [Your Name]”**

In your email, please let us know **which scene(s) you're interested in** and, if applicable, the **number/ages of children** you’d be bringing.

Feel free to **share this post** with anyone who might be interested! 🎬✨

No acting experience is necessary — just a willingness to participate and have fun on set!

**This is a volunteer production, so these are unpaid background roles.**

📍 **Location:** Surrey, BC
📅 **Date:** Monday, October 26th
🎥 **Roles:** Background actors + child extras

📧 **INTERESTED?**

Please email **wemetaliens2026@gmail.com** with the subject:

**“BG Available: [Your Name]”**

In your email, please let us know **which scene(s) you're interested in** and, if applicable, the **number/ages of children** you’d be bringing.

Feel free to **share this post** with anyone who might be interested! 🎬✨

WE’RE HIRING 🎭

As Bethan Jones Theatre Arts continues to grow, I’m looking for new teachers to join our team across Denbighshire (Rhyl/Dyserth) and Chester.

I’m happy to consider these positions separately, or there is the opportunity to take on multiple days if that suits you.

The role will mainly involve:
• One-to-one singing tuition.
• Musical theatre training.
• Preparing students for LCM examinations.
• Helping students develop their confidence, technique and performance skills.

Essential requirements:
• Current DBS.
• Able to travel to classes.
• Professional training in singing and/or musical theatre.
• Reliable, enthusiastic and committed.

I’m looking for someone who genuinely wants to be part of our school and is passionate about helping children grow, succeed and reach their potential.

This is a self-employed position, with invoices paid weekly.

If you feel this could be the right role for you, I’d love to hear from you.

📧 Bethan@bethanjonestheatrearts.co.uk

To find out more about our school and what we do, visit our social media or website:
www.bethanjonestheatrearts.co.uk

I’m really excited to find the right people to join our growing team!

🎬 KAMED STUDIO – NOWA PRODUKCJA FABULARNA
Nasza nowa produkcja fabularna przenosi się do Roztoki! 🎬

W związku z realizacją zdjęć poszukujemy statystów – kobiet, mężczyzn, seniorów, młodzieży oraz dzieci w wieku ok. 7–11 lat.

Szukamy również:

🚗 kierowców z własnymi samochodami, którzy mogą wystąpić w filmie razem z autem.

📅 Zdjęcia odbędą się w terminie 5–21 października.

📍 ROZTOKA

🚌 Dla osób z Wałbrzycha istnieje możliwość zorganizowania transportu produkcyjnego na plan.

👉 ZGŁOSZENIA PRZEZ FORMULARZ:

KLIKNIJ TUTAJ – FORMULARZ ZGŁOSZENIOWY⁠￼

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSedmV6jyYkfxi85xoioIkzLzKgOi4HMTwHKUMWw-1fa-i8okA/viewform?usp=header

Jeżeli ktoś ma problem z przesłaniem zgłoszenia przez formularz, prosimy o przesłanie zgłoszenia mailowo na:

📧 Roztoka.kamedstudio@gmail.com

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: ROZTOKA

W treści maila prosimy podać:

• imię i nazwisko

• numer telefonu

• adres zamieszkania

• informację, czy osoba dojeżdża na plan do Roztoki samodzielnie, czy potrzebuje transportu z Wałbrzycha

• dwa aktualne zdjęcia na jednolitym tle: portretowe + cała sylwetka

• w przypadku kierowców – dodatkowo zdjęcie samochodu, z którym mogą wystąpić w filmie.

Wysłanie zgłoszenia drogą mailową jest równoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie przesłanych danych osobowych przez Agencję Kamed Studio w związku z przeprowadzanym castingiem.

🎥 Zapraszamy do zgłoszeń!

items.text:
🎬 **ZAGRAJ W FILMIE! SZUKAMY STATYSTÓW NA SCENĘ IMPREZY!**

Dołącz do ekipy krótkometrażowego filmu dyplomowego **„Youth Parano”** (reż. Leon Korzyński i Witold Prokopczyk)!

Poprzedni film Leona został w tym roku wyróżniony **Studenckim Oscarem** (Academy Student Award) na festiwalu TIFF w Toronto – teraz ruszamy z kolejną, wyjątkową produkcją i potrzebujemy Waszej energii! 🔥

**O czym jest film?** To historia dwóch przyjaciół, którzy przeżywają ostatni dzień swoich ostatnich wspólnych wakacji.

**Kogo szukamy?** Przed nami realizacja jednej z największych i najbardziej energetycznych scen – **imprezy**, która jest kluczowym elementem całej historii. Zależy nam na stworzeniu pełnego, żywego klubowego świata, dlatego szukamy jak największej liczby osób, które staną z nami przed kamerą! 🕺💃

 

**SZCZEGÓŁY:**
* 📅 **Kiedy:** 10 października 2026 (sobota), w godz. 8:00 - 18:00
* 📍 **Gdzie:** Warszawa (jeden z warszawskich klubów)
* 💡 **Zasady:** Jako że jest to studencki film dyplomowy, projekt ma charakter **non-profit**.

Chcesz dołączyć do projektu i zagrać w filmie?

👉 **Wypełnij zgłoszenie tutaj:**[https://forms.gle/yRZGv4Cig3MozFaJ6](https://forms.gle/yRZGv4Cig3MozFaJ6)

**CASTING CALL – N.E.S.T. PROJECT**

@everyone

We’re looking for people to join us on **24th and 25th September** as we continue filming the N.E.S.T. Project in **Mossley, Tameside**.

Whether you’ve acted before or this is your first time in front of a camera, we’d love to hear from you. **No previous experience is required.**

N.E.S.T. is a voluntary independent film project, so this is an unpaid opportunity. Those involved will also have the opportunity to receive IMDb credits for their contribution to the project.

If you’re interested in getting involved, please email **casting@emberproduction.com** with a little information about yourself and your interest in joining the cast. Our team will be happy to provide further details.

We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who has supported the project so far, and we look forward to welcoming more people into the N.E.S.T. family.

**Dates:** 24th & 25th September

**Location:** Mossley, Tameside

**Experience:** None required

#NESTProject #EmberProductions #CastingCall #IndependentFilm #Mossley

🎬 CASTING CALL | WE NEED SOME MEAT 🥩

Right then... who's got the chops?

Sunny Runny Productions are on the hunt for PETE “THE MEAT” JENNINGS, a major supporting role in our debut feature film, No Gentle Goodnight, shooting in Runcorn from the end of October 2026.

Firstly, a massive thank you to Dave Oz for stepping in as Pete for our original proof-of-concept trailer. As we move into the full feature, we're now recasting the role.

PETE “THE MEAT” JENNINGS
Male | Playing age 50s -60s | Northern

Pete is a local butcher and an old face from David's past.

He's a hulking slab of sweat, sarcasm and questionable dietary choices, usually found in a butcher's apron with a pork pie in one hand and an opinion nobody asked for in the other.

Funny without trying to be. Rough around the edges. The sort of bloke you probably already know... and if you don't, you've definitely avoided eye contact with him in a pub.

But don't mistake Pete for comic relief.

There's a proper character underneath that apron and some cracking material for the right actor to get their teeth into.

We need presence. Someone who can make us laugh without playing for the laugh, handle the heavier dramatic stuff when it comes, and make Pete feel like a real bloke rather than a collection of Northern stereotypes.

THE FILM

No Gentle Goodnight is a British independent psychological crime thriller, written by Terence Caddick and directed by Mark Holland. Produced by Sunny Runny Productions & Going Nowhere Productions.

We're a low-budget independent production, and we're not pretending otherwise.

Our cast and crew are working on a contracted profit-share basis, because we'd rather be completely upfront about what we're doing from day one.

But low budget doesn't mean two blokes with an iPhone and a packet of crisps.

We're putting together a proper feature-film production with an experienced cast and crew, professional cinema equipment, structured shoot days and a team of people determined to make something we're all proud to put our names on.

We might be independent. We might be doing it differently.

But we're doing it properly.

🎥 Feature film
📍 Runcorn, Cheshire
📅 Principal photography begins end of October 2026
🎬 Approx. 4 filming days for Pete, subject to final schedule
📆 Filming predominantly Sundays
🎭 In-person auditions in Runcorn
💷 Contracted profit-share role
🍴 Catering provided on filming days
🎞️ Full screen credit

Experience is welcome, but we're much more interested in finding Pete than collecting the longest CV.

If you've got natural screen presence, good comic timing and can bring the dramatic chops when they're needed, we want to hear from you.

Send us your name, playing age, location, recent photo/headshot, acting experience/CV and a showreel if you have one. No showreel? Don't let that stop you. Tell us a little about yourself anyway.

Selected applicants will be invited to audition in Runcorn.

We've got the script.
We've got the cast.
We've got the crew.
We've got the locations.
We've got the kit.

We're just a bit short on MEAT. 🥩😂

EMAIL - casting@sunnyrunnyproductions.com

NO GENTLE GOODNIGHT | 2027 🎬

# **🎭 EMOTIONAL ACTING ADVICE: **Taking in Sensation 

**"An actor takes in sensation." ***~ Robert Lewis.*

My coach, Robert Lewis, said in class that actors take in sensation. 

**Meaning** we can sense our follow actors emotions and Intentions, sometimes without even saying a word. 

This heightened sensitivity is what makes us very instinctual and intuitive. 

This type of sensitivity makes you an actor people want to watch! It keeps your heart open, so you can be easily affected. ❤️

***𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗖𝗔𝗟𝗟 – 𝗭𝗔𝗚𝗥𝗘𝗕*** 

Za potrebe snimanja stranog igranog filma tijekom 𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗽𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗶 𝘀𝘁𝘂𝗱𝗲𝗻𝗼𝗴 u 𝗭𝗮𝗴𝗿𝗲𝗯𝘂 𝗶 𝗻𝗮 𝗣𝗮𝗴𝘂 tražimo veći broj statista iz Zagreba za 𝗥𝗔𝗭𝗡𝗘 𝗨𝗟𝗢𝗚𝗘. 

TRAŽIMO: 
* muškarce i žene u dobi od 𝟭𝟴 𝗱𝗼 𝟲𝟬 𝗴𝗼𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗮 

* posebno muškarce različitih dobnih skupina i u dobroj fizičkoj spremi, 𝗽𝗼𝘇̌𝗲𝗹𝗷𝗻𝗼 𝘁𝗮𝗺𝗻𝗶𝗷𝗲 𝗯𝗼𝗷𝗲 𝗸𝗼𝘀𝗲 𝗶 𝗽𝘂𝘁𝗶 

* ljude različitih etničkih i kulturnih podrijetla – posebno kandidate s područja 𝗦𝗷𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗲 𝗔𝗳𝗿𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗶 𝗕𝗹𝗶𝘀𝗸𝗼𝗴 𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗸𝗮 

*ljude alternativnijeg i "cool" izgleda

* svi izvan traženog profila su također dobrodošli 

𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 će se održati 𝘂 𝗛𝗢𝗧𝗘𝗟𝗨 𝗪𝗘𝗦𝗧𝗜𝗡 𝗨 𝗭𝗔𝗚𝗥𝗘𝗕𝗨 (𝗞𝗿𝘀̌𝗻𝗷𝗮𝘃𝗼𝗴𝗮 𝟭), u dvorani "ZRINJEVAC" 𝘂 𝗣𝗢𝗡𝗘𝗗𝗝𝗘𝗟𝗝𝗔𝗞 (𝟮𝟴.𝟵.), 𝗨𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗔𝗞 (𝟮𝟵.𝟵.) 𝗶 𝗦𝗥𝗜𝗝𝗘𝗗𝗨 (𝟯𝟬.𝟵.), 𝗼𝗱 𝟭𝟬:𝟬𝟬 𝗱𝗼 𝟭𝟴:𝟬𝟬 𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶. 

Pozivamo vas da dođete u što većem broju i da iskusite filmski set iz prve ruke, a da pritom steknete zanimljivo novo iskustvo i poznanstva. 😊 

Ako ste se prepoznali u objavi, ili poznajete nekoga za koga smatrate da odgovara opisu, proslijedite im oglas ili ih povedite sa sobom na casting. 😊
 
Veselimo se vašem odazivu i vidimo se! 

*𝗡𝗔𝗣𝗢𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗔: Ako NISTE u mogućnosti doći na casting, svoju prijavu za sudjelovanje možete poslati i na e-mail adresu: 

mp.produkcija.casting@gmail.com

items.text:
3 SPACES LEFT!

TV SCRIPT WORKSHOP

How different can the same scene feel when you play it opposite a different actor?

This October, we’ll be working with TV scripts, exploring scenes, characters, subtext and different ways of approaching the same material.

Two weeks before the session, you’ll receive a script to really familiarise yourself with — preferably learn it.

During the session, we’ll:

• Work on scenes and characters
• Explore different takes and interpretations
• Play with subtext and what’s happening beneath the words
• Experiment with different castings and scene partners
• Explore how the same script feels when played opposite different actors
• Film the scenes so you can watch your work back afterwards

The aim is to give you the opportunity to experiment, make choices and discover what happens when you approach a scene in different ways.

You’ll receive your filmed scenes after the session, giving you the chance to reflect on your work and see what you can learn from it.

WHEN: Saturday 10th October 2026, 2–5pm
WHERE: The Crescent Theatre, Birmingham
COST: £38, payable in advance

Places are strictly limited and your place is confirmed once payment has been received.

Come prepared to play, experiment and get stuck into some great TV material.

HOW TO BOOK: email estherstanford@icloud.com

www.estherstanford.co.uk

***PAID ~ LEAD ACTOR & SUPPORTING ACTOR***

Still searching for a **lead actor** and a **supporting actor ****theatre-trained preferred but not required** for my proof-of-concept short film, ***TATE-MONROE***. We are currently in pre-production, with the shoot date TBD in December in LA. We're also securing funds through donors, grants, contests, and a Seed&Spark crowdfunding campaign, so it will be a paid gig! 

If this sounds like an opportunity for you or someone you know, please have them email me at **willloperjr@gmail.com** with their portfolio. A little about the project below:

**TATE-MONROE: *****Caleb Pierce returns to Steele University’s campus after surviving the school shooting that took his brother’s life, only to discover the story being told is far from the unsettling truth.***

**Caleb Pierce (Inspo: Jharrel Jerome, Kelvin Harrison Jr.)**
* (late 10s/early 20s, Black) with a deep, Southern voice that echoes
* Business-casual athlete (5'11"-6'4, basketball)
* Dealing with PTSD and survivor's remorse

**Dr. Riley Miller (Inspo: Michael Shannon, Bryan Cranston)**
* (50s/60s, White), older, lanky, and balding with a Southern gentleman drawl
* Clean-cut, Brooks Brothers formal, business-minded
* A string of men trying to protect Steele's legacy

Additonal materials available upon request!  🙏🏽

Great opportunity to be seen all over YouTube also other outlets and promoted well. If interested please send headshots and resume call or txt me or send me a. This is a serious independent film 🎥 series that is being pitched to LA producers and TV outlets. 805-503-2456. Filming begins in November. Thank you 🎥🎥🏖️🏖️

items.text:
Exciting news from The AWA Lab! 🥳🎉
Some of you know how much I love helping actors move past that first obvious choice—so I made you guys an app 😭💜

Meet TAKE TWO, your little audition sidekick for exploring what else a scene could be through specific, playable choices.

It’s also perfect for when casting asks for two takes and you’re thinking… okay, what the hell do I do differently in Take 2? 😂

And it’s completely FREE.

Go play and tell me what you think! 

taketwo.theawalab.com

CASTING - publicité de parfum (projet étudiant)

On tourne à Angers le 3 et/ou 4 octobre 2026, en journée, pour une publicité de parfum fictive réalisée dans le cadre d'un exercice pédagogique et donné par Studio M Angers.

Tous les rôles filmés sont muets (aucune réplique à jouer), alors n'hésitez pas à candidater même sans expérience.

Les profils recherchés :

- L'égérie du parfum : un homme, 25 à 45 ans, profil charismatique. Corpulence athlétique et cheveux mi-longs à longs appréciés (assez pour simuler le vent dans les cheveux), mais tous les profils seront étudiés.

- La religieuse : une femme, 30 à 80 ans (voir plus), tous profils. Un rôle à jouer sur un ton sévère humoristique et décalé.

- La maman : une femme, 30 à 80 ans, tous profils.

- L'homme du parc : un homme, 25 à 80 ans, tous profils.

On cherche aussi une voix off homme pour la toute dernière phrase de la pub : une voix posée, grave, bien placée. Pas besoin d'être devant la caméra pour ce rôle, un extrait audio suffit à candidater. Vous pouvez candidater à plusieurs rôles.

Les rôles sont très ouverts côté physique, à l'exception peut-être de l'égérie du parfum : ne vous autocensurez pas, quel que soit votre profil.

Projet non payé/défrayé. Collations et boissons prévues sur place, repas fourni si le tournage déborde sur l'heure du déjeuner ou du dîner.

Aucune vocation commerciale : le parfum, la marque et la campagne sont entièrement fictifs, c'est un exercice de formation pour les étudiants en BTS Audiovisuel de Studio M Angers.

Pour candidater : envoyez-nous quelques photos récentes, votre âge, votre ville, et si vous en avez une, une bande-démo ou une vidéo de présentation (pour la voix off, un extrait audio est bienvenu).
Contact : goldenlight.rh@gmail.com ou DM.

**TVILLINGER SØGES TIL P3 SATIRE**

P3 Satire søger et tvillingepar, der ligner hinanden, til en sketch for P3 Satire med vært, Adnan Al-Adhami. 

Optagelsen foregår i DR Byen i København i morgen, fredag d. 25, kl. 9.00 og tager ca. 30 minutter. Der gives et honorar på 500 kr. pr. person. 

Det kræver ikke skuespillererfaring – bare at I er tvillinger og ligner hinanden godt. 

Hvis det lyder som jer, så send en sms til mig på 40 21 18 73, med et billede af jer begge. Del meget gerne opslaget med nogen, der kunne være relevante! :) 

Mvh Karoline Juul

40 21 18 73

DR P3 Satire

sharedPost.text:
Nasz krążek już prawie gotowy, jeszcze chwila. "Rozmowa" płyta, która zaczyna się muzycznym zaproszeniem, a kończy Twoją własną historią. To piosenki, których się słucha, są też takie, które zostają w sercu. "Rozmowa" to nasza muzyczna opowieść o emocjach, bliskości, tęsknocie i o tym, co czasem trudno powiedzieć słowami. "Rozmowa" jedna płyta, wiele historii.

Jak dobrze pójdzie, to już w Wąbrzeźnie podczas V Festiwalu Aleksandry Bacińskiej, płyta może być Twoja.

Aby Was zachęcić piosenka do słów Aleksandry Bacińskiej „ Potrzebny mi sweter” z muzyką Witolda Koziorowskiego, śpiewa Jola Trawnik.

✨🇨🇺🇬🇷 Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes algo MUY especial… 👀🎶💫 Pero esta vez no les voy a contar todo… 🤭🙈 Tendrán que ver el video hasta el final. 🎬🎤✨

Estoy súper feliz y agradecida por esta oportunidad de compartir música con una artista griega increíble:  Elissavet Stathi 🎤🇬🇷💖

Elissavet es una cantante con una voz súper dulce, sensible y al mismo tiempo con una fuerza y una potencia increíbles. 😍🎶🔥 Una artista que viene desarrollando su carrera aquí en Grecia 🇬🇷✨, con una sensibilidad muy especial para interpretar y transmitir a través de la música. 🎼💫❤️

Para mí ha sido un verdadero placer coincidir con ella y crear juntas este pequeño encuentro musical. 🥰🎤🎶 Dos culturas 🌍, dos idiomas 🗣️✨ y una canción que nos permitió encontrarnos en un mismo lugar: la música. ❤️🎵🇨🇺🇬🇷

Gracias, Elissavet, por esta hermosa oportunidad, por tu cariño y por compartir conmigo tu talento. 🫶🏻💖✨🎶

🎤🇨🇺🇬🇷 Cuba + Grecia = Música sin fronteras 🌍🎶💫❤️

Y ahora sí… 👀👇
¿Te gustó esta versión tanto como a mí? 😍🎶
¡Déjamelo saber en los comentarios! 💬👇❤️✨

items.text:
***** CASTING CALL — PAID Social Media Shoot *****

Seeking 3 talents (any gender) for a quick, PAID social media video shoot for a cafe in the East Van/Mt. Pleasant area. Experience is a plus, but not required!

**Roles:** (any gender)
* **Michelle** — A fitness-loving young lady on her way home from a fitness class, stopping by the cafe to grab a drink as a reward.
* **Monica **(+ your dog!) — An avid dog-lover getting her dog ready for a walk when she notices the rain. She heads to the cafe to enjoy a drink on the patio while her dog lounges beside her.
* **David** — A burnt-out remote worker who looks outside, sees the rain, and packs up to head to the cafe to keep working in a social space while enjoying a drink.

**Details:**
* Pay: $100 flat, all-in (Non-union)
* Time commitment: 1–2 hours total
* **Shoot date is weather-dependent (rainy day required) — exact date TBD, between Sep 28 - Oct 9.** Please only apply if you are relatively flexible in the morning-afternoon time slot, and would be available with a 1-2 day notice.
* Footage will be used for the cafe’s Instagram page, but may be posted on their website and other social media platforms.
* Free coffee!

**To Apply:**

Please send a few recent photos + your name, phone number, and general availability (which days/times you could flex to) to **[casting@grainycity.com](mailto:casting@grainycity.com)**** **and we’ll get in touch. You don’t have to specify the character, but please let us know if you are a dog-owner!

items.text:
Jigsaw Casting Ltd. Is Seeking Cigarette Smokers ages 30+ across Canada who have cut back or are trying to quit for a ZONNIC Testimonial Campaign!

We are looking for the following people:
1. Individuals who are actively quitting or cutting back with ZONNIC. You are currently using the product and able to speak to it first-hand.

2. Individuals who are looking to quit or cut back — and you are open to trying ZONNIC. You are motivated to change the habit, not yet a ZONNIC user. You are open to trying the product ahead of the shoot.

3. Individuals who have tried other NRTs without success — open to switching. Those who have attempted to quit with other nicotine replacement therapies that did not work.

4. Individuals who have recently quit by using ZONNIC.

If selected – This is a compensated, non-union project, with total potential compensation of up to $5,100.00 per person, depending on final usage and survival of the edit. Buyout includes all lifts, edits and versions for a 1 year period.

Requirements
• Aged 30+ and visually read as 30+ on camera.
• Resides in Canada. Everyday Canadians from diverse backgrounds
• Currently smokes and is either cutting back or looking to quit, able to describe it unprompted.
• Comfortable speaking honestly and being publicly attributed.

DEADLINE TO SUBMIT - ASAP OR BEFORE OCTOBER 7, 2026 AT 9AM EST.
You must be available for these dates if selected:

Recall: October 16 via in person (Montreal) or zoom (other cities).

Shoot: 1 day in between Nov 19 to 30. Location TBD: Either in Montreal, Toronto or Vancouver. Travel and accommodation will be provided if you don't live close to the studio in one of those cities. Travel dates will be 1 or 2 days before the shoot.

If interested, you must apply and submit a self tape to:
https://zonniccampaign.castingcrane.com/

Self tape instructions:
1. Introduce yourself.
2. What makes you want to quit or cut back?
3. What personal goals is ZONNIC helping you unlock?

Talent przyciąga uwagę. A co sprawia, że publiczność zapamiętuje występ? Emocje, osobowość sceniczna i kontakt z widzami. 🎭

Nazywam się Katarzyna Maria Zawadzka. Jestem aktorką, trenerką aktorstwa i pedagogiem. Wspieram dzieci i młodzież występujące w tańcu, śpiewie, akrobatyce, aktorstwie, recytacji i innych dziedzinach artystycznych.

Pomagam młodym artystom wzmacniać pewność siebie na scenie, rozwijać ekspresję emocjonalną i przyciągać uwagę publiczności oraz jury. Pracujemy nad tym, by mogli pokazać nie tylko swoje umiejętności, ale też własną osobowość.

Jeśli Twoje dziecko przygotowuje się do występu lub konkursu, napisz do mnie: kmzawadzkatrener@gmail.com. Chętnie porozmawiam o tym, jak mogę je wesprzeć.

Gramy przed szpitalem i na sali operacyjnej

US American Accent Intensive with Sandra Bell
Saturday 17 October 2026, 10am to 4:30pm
Queensland Headshots studio, 1192 Stanley Street East, Coorparoo

Sandra has been coaching the American accent on film sets, schools and agencies for 32 years, with over 1,000 actors attending workshops and private lessons in every major Australian city. This one-day intensive is her intro to the American accent, and it suits newcomers and returning students alike.

We cover the basics in the morning with individual feedback on camera. You'll get a script a few days before class to learn, and we film your US accent scene in the afternoon. We then edit it and send it to you ready for your showreel.

🎬 Small group, 8 to 10 actors
💲 $260, or $240 if you've trained with Sandra before
✅ $50 non-refundable deposit holds your place, balance due 48 hours before class
🎭 16 and over, 14 and 15 year olds considered case by case

Places go in order of deposit. Register here: https://queenslandheadshots.com/sandrabell/

Questions: info@queenslandheadshots.com or 0403 871 686

🎶Thinking about voice lessons? Free Trial Lessons Available!🎶

Looking for a fun, supportive voice teacher for you or your child? Give them the opportunity to build confidence, strengthen their voice, and develop their performance skills all from the comfort of home!

Hi! I’m Colleen, a professional actress/singer, and voice and piano teacher! I offer private voice lessons entirely online through Zoom.

✨ Beginner-friendly

🎶 Musical theatre, pop & more

🎤 Build vocal technique and confidence

💻 Convenient online lessons from home

❤️ In-person recitals in Milwaukee at least 2x per year!

If your child has been singing around the house, dreaming of performing, or just wants to try something new this school year, this is a great time to get started.

Fill out our free trial lesson form and I’ll be in touch!

www.virtuosostudios.org/free-trial-lessons

🚨🔥 NOCH EINMAL AUFGEMACHT! 🔥🚨

FREUNDE 😍😍😍!!
Ihr habt uns nach einem weiteren Termin gefragt und deshalb legen wir am 01. & 02. November 2026 noch einmal nach 👮‍♂️🎬!

Wir öffnen dafür nur noch wenige Plätze für unseren POLIZEI-AUFBAU-WORKSHOP.

Und das ist definitiv kein klassischer Schauspielworkshop. 😉

Hier geht’s um das, was man auf der Kamera sehen muss: authentisches Verhalten, sichere Abläufe und glaubwürdiges Agieren in realitätsnahen Einsatzsituationen.

🎬 Realistische Einsatzszenarien
👮 Personenkontrollen, Durchsuchungen & Fesselungstechniken
🚔 Personentransport & Verbringen ins Einsatzfahrzeug
🥋 Selbstverteidigung & Umgang mit aggressiven Personen
🔫 Professionelles Waffenhandling
🎯 Betreutes Schießtraining auf einer Schießanlage
💥 Training unter Stress & situatives/taktisches Agieren

Tag 2 steht komplett im Zeichen des Schießtrainings – professionell angeleitet und in kleinen Trainingsgruppen.

📍 01.11.2026 – Dachau
📍 02.11.2026 – Schießanlage Oberschleißheim

⚠️ WICHTIG: Das ist ein AUFBAU-Workshop.

Er richtet sich an Teilnehmer, die bereits unseren Basis-Workshop absolviert haben oder entsprechende berufliche bzw. langjährige praktische Erfahrung mitbringen.

Zum Beispiel aus:
👮 Polizei
🪖 Bundeswehr
⚖️ Justiz
🛡️ Sicherheitsdienst
🎬 oder durch umfangreiche Erfahrung mit Polizeirollen vor der Kamera

Wir schauen uns jede Anmeldung individuell an und klären vorab, ob dein Erfahrungsstand für den Aufbau-Workshop passt.

Denn genau das macht den Unterschied:
Wir wollen nicht einfach möglichst viele Teilnehmer – wir wollen, dass die richtigen Leute miteinander trainieren können 🔥.

📩 Infos, Preis & Anmeldung:
Schreibt uns an info@komparse.tv

Wenn du also schon Erfahrung mitbringst und Polizeirollen vor der Kamera auf das nächste Level bringen willst:
👉 Meld dich jetzt.

Die Plätze sind bewusst begrenzt – und wenn sie voll sind, sind sie voll 👮‍♂️🔥🎬😜!

Wir sehen uns in Dachau & Oberschleißheim! ❤️‍🔥

#dubistfilm #komparse #komparsen #polizeidarstellung #polizeiworkshop

Chicago, IL 

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall

Written & Directed by Matthew Stevens

Dear Actors and Performers,

FlightTime Productions is excited to announce auditions for our upcoming stage play, Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, written and directed by Matthew Stevens.

We are currently seeking performers to fill two important roles in the production and invite interested actors to audition.

Auditions will be held on Friday, October 9, 2026, with appointment times available at 10:30 AM, 11:30 AM, 12:30 PM, 1:30 PM, and 2:30 PM.

Auditions are by appointment only and will take place at:

Woodson Regional Library Auditorium
9525 S. Halsted Street
Chicago, IL 60628

Please note that this production is not associated with Woodson Regional Library.

Roles Currently Needing Cast

BROOKLYN — The daughter of rival airline CEO Miss Brooks. Brooklyn initially plays around with the idea of spying on Diva Airways for her mother, but as she becomes more involved, she begins to feel that Diva Airways is something worth saving.

COLIN — Alexa’s brother. While heading out on a flight to Las Vegas for a visit, Colin stops to check in with his sister. He is deeply hurt that Alexa has distanced herself and has not been communicating with their family.

Actors should be prepared to perform scenes from the show during their audition.

To request an audition appointment, please email divaairwaysstage@gmail.com with the audition time or times for which you are available. Requests must be received by October 8, 2026, at 11:00 PM.

Rehearsals will begin Sunday, January 10, 2027, and will initially be held twice per week. Beginning in early March 2027, rehearsals will increase to three times per week as we prepare for performances.

Performances are currently scheduled for Thursday through Sunday, April 8–May 30, 2027, with the possibility of an extension depending on revenue and popularity.

We are excited to welcome new performers into the world of Diva Airways and look forward to meeting everyone who auditions. Whether you’re joining us as Brooklyn or Colin, this is an opportunity to become part of the continuing journey of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall.

Thank you for your interest in FlightTime Productions. We look forward to seeing you at auditions!

Warm regards,

Matthew Stevens
Writer & Director
FlightTime Productions
Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall
divaairwaysstage@gmail.com

Be a Part of the Journey

items.text:
**PAID CASTING CALL - TV PILOT (Multiple characters)**

**Project:** "Deadly Chess Royale", a gothic steampunk Live Action Anime Thriller (yes, Live Action Anime like Netflix's One Piece Live Action Anime)
**Location: **New York City
**Showrunner, Producer, Director: **Tiger Lapis
**Production Dates:** Between Nov 1, 2026 to Jan 1, 2027 (exact dates TBD)
**Union Status: **Open to Union and Non-Union actors, but this will be a SAG Union shoot (We will Taft-Hartley Non-Union actors)
**Compensation: **TBD based on Role (SAG Union Rate)

**About the Series:**
Two women geniuses battle in chess to choose who dies as one seeks revenge and the other fights to follow her heart in a futuristic gothic New York City.  One is Detective Julia Jeng, the genius detective and Master Strategist leading the white chess team.  The other is her former childhood friend, Officer Julia Cho, the Master Manipulator leading the black chess team. 
The series is like "Alice in Borderland" meets "The Queen's Gambit" and "Death Note". 

**Casting for the Following Characters:**

**1) Detective Julia Jeng, Lead**
Age: Looks like in their late 20s

Ethnicity: East Asian (will consider mixed-race East Asian)

Height: at least 5'4" or TALLER 
Fit 

Willing to do action/fight scenes (you will have a LOT) 

Character is like a beautiful Tomboy 

Prefer someone with some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 

*Highly Preferred if you also have a deep, low voice 
*Actress needs to have a strong physical presence, and action-hero confidence with emotional vulnerability.

*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you 

Genius Detective Julia Jeng (leader of the White Chess Team) fights to stay true to who she wants to be in a world that tries to force her to be someone she's not.  A Master Strategist and a tough, strong woman who is intense, like an untouchable blade, she's also quirky, blunt, direct, sarcastic, and a bit of an oblivious idiot when it comes to romance.  Although her social skills are a bit lacking and she doesn't open up easily (nor does she like to be vulnerable), she's quite lonely, and has suffered major trauma when her family was destroyed.  Still, she tries her best to never give up.  A very passionate person who gives it her all, she is the one who fights with love in her heart.   Most importantly, this is a woman who must inspire the audience. This is someone who can do the impossible and believes she can do the impossible.  She doesn't conform to society, she doesn't fit in, but no one else is like her.  She'll go through an incredibly difficult journey in the show through deadly chess games she must play against her former childhood best friend to choose who dies, and is forced with morally-complicated choices as the world tries to force her to be someone she doesn't want to be. 
There is romantic tension between Detective Julia Jeng and lead male, Detective Kazuki Kamijo.
FYI this is NOT NCIS or that type of show.  This is a Gothic Steampunk Noir Thriller ala Tim Burton inspired style, similar to the tone, vibe, and world of Tim Burton's "Batman Returns".   And is very much a Live Action Anime, similar to how One Piece is a live action Anime.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 14-16 days of filming for your role + rehearsals for fight choreography **(see below how to Submit)**

**2) Detective Kazuki Kamijo, Lead**
Age: Looks like in their Late 20s or early 30s

Ethnicity: East Asian OR mixed-race East Asian

Height: at least 5'9" -  6'4" or taller 
Fit 

Willing to do action/fight scenes (you will have a LOT) 

Prefer someone with some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 

*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you 

Detective Kazuki Kamijo (on the White Chess Team) is the lead male character and the right-hand man of Detective Julia Jeng in the Deadly Chess Games she must play against her former childhood best friend, The Master Manipulator Officer Cho.  Kazuki is a strong, grounded character who is wise, sincere, deeply compassionate, has a great balance of strength with a soft side to him, a bit of dry humor, is incredibly smart, and the one who grounds the lead protagonist Detective Julia Jeng, his best friend whom he has worked together with before.  Whereas Officer Cho tries to seduce Julia Jeng into the darkness of revenge, Kazuki tries to keep Julia Jeng in the light. There is strong Romantic tension between him and Julia Jeng as well.  Actor must be able to deliver words of wisdom. This is a deep character. Kazuki is loyal to the New York Police Department and the top shooter on the force. He is also one of the best fighters on the White Chess Team, with incredible combat skills and abilities. There are also layers to Detective Kazuki Kamijo as this is a complex character.  There is more to this guy. 

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 8-10 days of filming for your role **(see below how to Submit)**

**3) Helen Nakamura, the ASSASSIN (series regular)**
Age: Looks like in their early 20s or Younger 
Ethnicity: East Asian (prefer Japanese)
Willing to do action/fight scenes (you will have a LOT) 

Prefer someone with some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 
*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you

Helen Nakamura, the ASSASSIN (on the Black Chess Team). She is psychotic and the most volatile and mentally unstable character in the entire series. Also deemed the best and most dangerous fighter on the black chess team. Although she is in her 20s, she dresses like a young Japanese schoolgirl due to a traumatic event that left her frozen mentally in that time period. She uses her youthful looks to her advantage on her unsuspecting targets. She is the right-hand woman of the Master Manipulator, former police officer Cho, who leads the black chess team. A bit of Cho's pet, she is intensely loyal to Cho and no one else, which is why Cho is the only one who can control her.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 3-6 days of filming for your role + rehearsals for fight choreography **(see below how to Submit)**

**4) John Cho, the ARSONIST, Series Regular**
Age: Looks like in their 20s to early 30s 

Ethnicity: East Asian (prefer Korean)

Willing to do action/fight scenes 
Added bonus if you have some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 

*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you 

John Cho, the ARSONIST (on the White Chess Team). He is the Korean bad boy of the series. Pretty much a total a**hole, and nearly all his teammates dislike him as he can't get along with anyone. Obsessed with fire, he is highly skilled when it comes to using fire as a weapon, understanding the inner mechanics of how it flows and works. He has a highly self-destructive personality and is an avid smoker, where most of the time you will see him with a cigarette in his mouth. (Note: Actor will NOT smoke real cigarettes) He is highly artistic though, known for his illegal graffiti art. No one wants to work with him. He says everything offensive to everyone around him. He does, however, has a bit of a chill uncaring personality, and doesn't talk much unless to offend someone. Most of the time, he looks like he doesn't give a f*** about anything. A bit of a nihilist, he hides his feelings behind a traumatic past.

**5) Raven Chan, the THIEF (series regular)**

Must have MARTIAL ARTS EXPERIENCE! 

*This role requires a lot of martial arts choreography and fight scenes. We are looking for someone who is a highly trained martial artist! If you have ROPE DART experience, it's an added plus! 

Raven Chan, the THIEF (on the Black Chess Team), is a notorious professional thief who is hired to steal artifacts, antiques, and paintings worth millions of dollars. He also has a string of successful bank robberies under his belt. His motto is, “Anything you ask, I’ll steal.” Oddly chauvinistic, a trickster, and even polite (when he’s not fighting). He is jokingly known as the “Hong Kong pop star” given his beautiful looks, and is recognized for his premature snow white hair that has been caused by a traumatic childhood event. Raven is an avid violin player, often carrying a violin case on his back. What others don’t realize is that in his violin case hides a dangerous martial arts weapon. He is in a romantic relationship with Em.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 4-7 days of filming for your role + rehearsals for fight choreography **(see below how to Submit)**

* Headshot

**PAID CASTING CALL - TV PILOT (Multiple characters)**

**Project:** "Deadly Chess Royale", a gothic steampunk Live Action Anime Thriller (yes, Live Action Anime like Netflix's One Piece Live Action Anime)
**Location: **New York City
**Showrunner, Producer, Director: **Tiger Lapis
**Production Dates:** Between Nov 1, 2026 to Jan 1, 2027 (exact dates TBD)
**Union Status: **Open to Union and Non-Union actors, but this will be a SAG Union shoot (We will Taft-Hartley Non-Union actors)
**Compensation: **TBD based on Role (SAG Union Rate)

**About the Series:**
Two women geniuses battle in chess to choose who dies as one seeks revenge and the other fights to follow her heart in a futuristic gothic New York City.  One is Detective Julia Jeng, the genius detective and Master Strategist leading the white chess team.  The other is her former childhood friend, Officer Julia Cho, the Master Manipulator leading the black chess team. 
The series is like "Alice in Borderland" meets "The Queen's Gambit" and "Death Note". 

**Casting for the Following Characters:**

**1) Detective Julia Jeng, Lead**
Age: Looks like in their late 20s

Ethnicity: East Asian (will consider mixed-race East Asian)

Height: at least 5'4" or TALLER 
Fit 

Willing to do action/fight scenes (you will have a LOT) 

Character is like a beautiful Tomboy 

Prefer someone with some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 

*Highly Preferred if you also have a deep, low voice 
*Actress needs to have a strong physical presence, and action-hero confidence with emotional vulnerability.

*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you 

Genius Detective Julia Jeng (leader of the White Chess Team) fights to stay true to who she wants to be in a world that tries to force her to be someone she's not.  A Master Strategist and a tough, strong woman who is intense, like an untouchable blade, she's also quirky, blunt, direct, sarcastic, and a bit of an oblivious idiot when it comes to romance.  Although her social skills are a bit lacking and she doesn't open up easily (nor does she like to be vulnerable), she's quite lonely, and has suffered major trauma when her family was destroyed.  Still, she tries her best to never give up.  A very passionate person who gives it her all, she is the one who fights with love in her heart.   Most importantly, this is a woman who must inspire the audience. This is someone who can do the impossible and believes she can do the impossible.  She doesn't conform to society, she doesn't fit in, but no one else is like her.  She'll go through an incredibly difficult journey in the show through deadly chess games she must play against her former childhood best friend to choose who dies, and is forced with morally-complicated choices as the world tries to force her to be someone she doesn't want to be. 
There is romantic tension between Detective Julia Jeng and lead male, Detective Kazuki Kamijo.
FYI this is NOT NCIS or that type of show.  This is a Gothic Steampunk Noir Thriller ala Tim Burton inspired style, similar to the tone, vibe, and world of Tim Burton's "Batman Returns".   And is very much a Live Action Anime, similar to how One Piece is a live action Anime.

*Schedule: Most likely will need around 14-16 days of filming for your role + rehearsals for fight choreography **(see below how to Submit)**

**2) Detective Kazuki Kamijo, Lead**
Age: Looks like in their Late 20s or early 30s

Ethnicity: East Asian OR mixed-race East Asian

Height: at least 5'9" -  6'4" or taller 
Fit 

Willing to do action/fight scenes (you will have a LOT) 

Prefer someone with some martial arts / kickboxing or fight experience 

*If you are Non-Union, we will Taft-Hartley you 

Detective Kazuki Kamijo (on the White Chess Team) is the lead male character and the right-hand man of Detective Julia Jeng in the Deadly Chess Games she must play against her former childhood best friend, The Master Manipulator Officer Cho.  Kazuki is a strong, grounded character who is wise, sincere, deeply compassionate, has a great balance of strength with a soft side to him, a bit of dry humor, is incredibly smart, and the one who grounds the lead protagonist Detective Julia Jeng, his best friend whom he has worked together with before.  Whereas Officer Cho tries to seduce Julia Jeng into the darkness of revenge, Kazuki tries to keep Julia Jeng in the light. There is strong Romantic tension between him and Julia Jeng as well.  Actor must be able to deliver words of wisdom. This is a deep character. Kazuki is loyal to the New York Police Department and the top shooter on the force. He is also one of the best fighters on the White Chess Team, with incredible combat skills and abilities. There are also layers to Detective Kazuki Kamijo as this is a complex character.  There is more to this guy.

📍 Location: Bewl Water, Lamberhurst, Kent

💷 Rate: £25 per hour

🚗 Local performers preferred due to the rural location

Sunday 6th December

Saturday 12th December

Sunday 13th December

Saturday 19th December

Thursday 24th December

Please share with any brilliant Santas who might be interested! 🎄

🔴 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na prywatną wiadomość krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

Abby Roberge + Ari Mannis + Impact Fest After Hours

Saturday, 26 September | Warsaw

Impact Fest has added one more Saturday-night show.

American-based comedians Abby Roberge and Ari Mannis are in Warsaw, and both are performing a full stand-up set before the festival moves into its late-night after-hours session.

That means headline stand-up, followed by comedians from Impact Fest, Warsaw and around the world taking over the stage through the night.

ABBY ROBERGE

Originally from Vancouver and now based in Los Angeles, Abby Roberge was selected as a Just For Laughs New Face and has performed across the US and Canada, including residencies at the Laugh Factory in Las Vegas. He has appeared on Modern Family, NBC’s So Close and CBC’s Comedy Night with Rick Mercer.

Abby has toured with comedians including Bill Burr, Russell Peters and Bob Saget, and his stand-up and sketch videos have accumulated more than 100 million views, according to his Laugh Factory biography.

ARI MANNIS

Los Angeles-based comedian Ari Mannis performs internationally as a headliner and has toured opening for comedians including Mark Normand, Theo Von, Andrew Santino, Dan Soder, Erik Griffin, Michael Kosta and Pauly Shore.

His comedy has appeared through MTV, SiriusXM, Nerdist, Funny or Die, CollegeHumor and TBS, and he has performed at festivals including Laughing Skull, Big Pine and Laugh Your Asheville Off.

AND THEN THE NIGHT KEEPS MOVING

After Abby and Ari finish, the festival shifts into Draw From The Hat, Impact Fest After Hours.

Comedians visiting Warsaw for Impact Fest join local performers, names go into the hat and the lineup develops throughout the night.

We know who starts the evening.

We are much less certain who finishes it.

SATURDAY NIGHT

Abby Roberge 

Ari Mannis 

Then: Draw From The Hat - Impact Fest After Hours

TICKETS

49 PLN online

60 PLN at the door, subject to availability

Included with Impact Fest Saturday Pass and Weekend Pass

Saturday, 26 September 2026

Impact Fest 2026 Warsaw

Come for two full international headline sets. Stay to see how far into Sunday we get.

🌌 CASTING CALL 🌌
left eddy stories are casting for a preview performance of ‘Beneath The Camouflage Tree’ on 5th Nov at Forest Arts Centre in New Milton. We recently had a well-received performance at White Bear Theatre (aka ‘South London’s New Writing Powerhouse’ - The Stage), and have been shortlisted for the Vault Creative Arts Playwrighting Award(!), so we’re excited to do another regional preview before our small scale tour launches in 2027…

For this preview, we are looking for a female and/or gender-queer actor, based in Hampshire/Dorset to play opposite Francesca McBride (Single White Female, Generation Z, Boarders) as either JACK, a quiet but observant Lance Corporal, or EVELYN, a fiesty and playful young woman disguised as Private Anthony Fielding. If you are available from 26th Oct-5th Nov and interested in applying, please complete the application form in our link.tree: linktr.ee/BeneathTheCamouflageTree

We are asking applicants to complete the short form and tape ONE of two scene options for the role they feel like the best fit for - please choose the scene you feel most comfortable and confident with! 💙 

We’re so excited to see what everyone brings to the table 😊 

🌌 DEADLINE TO APPLY: 5pm, Monday 28th Sept 🌌 
•
#casting #theatreaudition #lgbtq #actor #hampshirearts

It follows fictional characters Jack and Tony, inspired by a composite of many real women soldiers', against the backdrop of an observation post in WW1, examining the complexity of relationships, identity, and grief. The piece has a Preview scheduled at Forest Arts Centre in New Milton on 5t November before embarking on a small-scale tour in 2027.'

She is feisty, playful and brave, with a fire of defiance that can't be stopped. We are interested in hearing from actors who identify as LGBTQ+ for this role, but are open to applications from anyone who feels they could be a good fit.'

Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

🔴 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na prywatną wiadomość krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

**Zaprzyjaźnij się ze swoim ciałem i uwolnij emocje na warsztatach tanecznych!**

U nas profesjonalizm spotyka się z dbałością o dobrostan i poczuciem bezpieczeństwa uczestników.

Odwiedź stronę FB Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie lub Czuła Fundacja. Możesz też odwiedzić naszą stronę internetową: https://www.czulafundacja.pl/ 

Dowiedz się więcej o czułej i twórczej przestrzeni, którą dla Ciebie budujemy.

Poznaj prowadzącego grupę SQARE Kacper Mucha. Kacper jest profesjonalnym tancerzem i choreografem. Ale nie zapomniał o tym, co dawał mu taniec w dzieciństwie. Był sposobem na rozładowanie energii i emocji z całego dnia.

"Pracuję z uczestnikami nad większym poczuciem własnej wartości i lepszym osadzeniem w swoim ciele. Wzmacniamy je i rozwijamy koordynację ruchową. Dzięki temu zaprzyjaźniamy się ze swoim ciałem i emocjami. Obserwujeny siebie i swoje reakcje. Poznajemy sami siebie. Chcę, żeby „Square” było dla Was bezpiecznym miejscem, w którym uczycie się zaufania do siebie i świata, zglębiając profesjonalne techniki taneczne".

Jeżeli chcesz poszukać tańca w sobie i siebie w tańcu, dać sobie przestrzeń na rozwój i po prostu się poruszać — przyjdź do nas!

Grupa SQUARE startuje już w najbliższy poniedziałek 21 września o 18.00 na ul. Marymonckiej 34!

Poniższe zdjęcie jest z uroczystej Gali Zakończenia Sezonu Artystycznego, którą co roku organizujemy w naszej Fundacji. Na Gali prezentują się wszyscy chętni uczestnicy naszych zajęć. Wspieramy się wzajemnie i tworzymy pełne zaufania więzi. Dołącz do naszej społeczności!

Bądź z nami w najbliższy poniedziałek! Zapraszamy młodzież I dorosłych.

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się więcej - napisz do nas na adres: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl

Casting-Call für Haunted-Guilt Kurzfilm
Kurzfassung der Handlung: 

Eingesperrt in einer tristen, erdrückenden Realität versucht Sofia, sich von ihren Lasten zu befreien. Doch ein psychologischer Albtraum bricht herein, als die Vergangenheit und die engen Wände sie einholen! 

Für alle Rollen Sprachliche Anforderung: Verhandlungssicheres / fließendes Englisch (da das Skript auf Englisch verfasst ist und in Englisch gefilmt werden soll).

Hinweis: Ich poste von einem privaten Account aus, der in letzter Zeit nicht viel aktiv war – bei Fragen meldet euch aber sehr gerne direkt per E-Mail an philippbrendel2@gmail.com oder hier im Messenger!

**Crew Call - Los Angeles** NO/LOW PAY

I'm looking for crew for a short film that will be used for a promotional and crowdfunding campaign. The writer/director and cinematographer are AFI alumni with established producers onboard. It will be a weekend 2 day shoot, currently targeting to film either October 10-11 or 17-18. Locations are yet to be confirmed but likely around LA and potentially Boyle Heights.

About the film:
The film follows a TikTok star suffering from an anxiety attack while stranded inside his trailer during a film shoot, but an unexpected encounter with a production assistant forces him out of his isolation and into a brief connection with the world around him. Our film explores the complexities of anxiety, isolation, and the self-imposed pressures we face in our pursuit of success.

As this is no-budget, we're only able to offer small stipends or kit fees. Although our goal is to find the crew we want to continue working with for the feature as well.

We're currently looking for:
Costume/Prop Master combo ($200 flat stipend/kit fee)
Sound Mixer w/gear ($300 flat stipend/kit fee)
Script Supervisor ($200 flat stipend/kit fee)
Intimacy Coordinator (1 day only, probably 8 hrs, $100 flat)

We are covered generally for other positions, but please feel free to send your resume in case of last minute availability changes.

If interested in collaborating, please email  sarahniver@gmail.com with your desired position in the subject line along with your resume or CV and portfolio (if applicable). Thank you so much!

🎬 PAID CASTING CALL — LOS ANGELES / PALMDALE AREA

THE COLONY — Sci-Fi / Horror Short Film
Proof of Concept for a Feature Film

📍 Location: Palmdale / High Desert, CA
📅 Shoot: Late September / Early October
⏱ Approx. 6–8 hours
🎥 Festival submissions + online release
🍴 Meals provided + transportation/gas stipend

CASTING:

MAYA — Female Lead | 25–35 | $200

* Level-headed, observant, resilient
* Athletic / physically capable
* Recently out of a difficult relationship
* Starts reserved but becomes the group’s survivor
* Significant physical/action performance
* Lead role

TRISH — Female Supporting | 25–35 | $125

* Sara’s close friend
* Social, confident, adventurous
* Strong chemistry with Sara
* Must be comfortable in a bikini for a hot-tub scene
* Horror/action sequences

RYAN — Male Supporting | 25–35 | $125

* Video game developer
* Trish’s boyfriend
* Funny, laid-back, slightly immature
* Comedic relief before the horror escalates
* Must be comfortable shirtless for a hot-tub scene

ABOUT THE FILM:
The Colony is a sci-fi horror creature short inspired by classic creature features. A group of friends head to a desert getaway, only to discover something deadly lurking beneath the property.

The short is being produced as a proof of concept for a feature-length film, combining live-action filmmaking with professional creature VFX.

TO SUBMIT:
Please DM with:
• Headshot / recent photo
• Acting reel or clips (if available)
• Role you’re interested in
• Availability late September / early October
• Los Angeles-area location

Paid, non-union independent production.

Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

🔴 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na prywatną wiadomość krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

🎬 **BEZAHLTER COMEDY-WERBEDREH: **

**Frau ca. 45–65 Jahre für diesen Freitag in Wien gesucht**

Für ein kurzes Social-Media-Werbevideo mit einem bekannten österreichischen Creator suchen wir kurzfristig eine sympathische, humorvolle Frau, die gerne vor der Kamera steht.

**Die Rolle:**
Du spielst überspitzt eine verliebte österreichische Urlauberin, die ihren jüngeren nordafrikanischen Urlaubspartner am Flughafen abholt. Der Clip ist eine klar erkennbare und humorvolle Parodie auf bekannte TV-Datingformate (Amore unter Palmen etc.).

**Drehdetails:**
📅 Freitag, 25. September
🕗 Start gegen 8/9 Uhr
⏱ Ca. 3–4 Stunden
📍 Wien und eine kurze Szene beim Flughafen
💶 Bezahlter Dreh – Vergütung inkludiert
🎥 Veröffentlichung als Social-Media-Werbevideo (mit Rechten zur Nutzung und Bewerbung)

Schauspielerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich! Wichtig sind Humor, Natürlichkeit, Lockerheit vor der Kamera und die Bereitschaft, die verliebte Rolle etwas überspitzt zu spielen.

Bei Interesse bitte möglichst rasch eine kurze Nachricht mit Foto, Telefonnummer und, falls vorhanden, einem kurzen Video oder Social-Media-Profil schicken. 😊

Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas Goersch
